baseline_models.focus_anchor: The companion noun at word 2, garden noun at word 3, enduring participle at word 4, recompense at word 6, and durative work clause at words 8-9 form one chain.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purposeful activity is answered by incorporation into a cultivated, sheltering company whose defining condition is stable continuance.

activation_trace.role: Continued association supplies the social bond that makes the destination a membership rather than merely owned space.
A tree-covered enclosure supplies the cultivated and sheltering place in which the company belongs.
Stable survival without quick decay turns residence into the settled condition of the company.
An answering return for action supplies the causal link between practice and residence.
Occurrence extended through past time makes the work clause a lived pattern rather than an isolated act.
Intentional doing supplies the human practice to which the durable condition responds.

changed_reading.before: A group receives a garden as a reward.
changed_reading.after: Sustained intentional practice is answered by durable membership in a sheltered cultivated company and place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2-6 allow companionship, enclosure, adhesion, and recompense to be read as one protective relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden is not only where the recipients stay; it becomes the preserving companion fitted to them, while recompense is what stands in for and suffices for their work.

activation_trace.role: Preservation through accompaniment makes companionship itself protective.
Making one thing accompany and suit another lets the garden be fitted to its people.
A defensive covering gives the garden an active shielding function.
Adhesion and remaining close make protection a relation that does not detach.
One thing standing in the place of another casts recompense as a sufficient answering provision.

changed_reading.before: The garden is only a location occupied by its recipients.
changed_reading.after: The garden is also a preserving companion and shield fitted to the recipients as an enduring answering provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The recompense noun at word 6 and work verb at word 9 support an economic-accounting model.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recompense can be heard as an account brought to settlement and the lasting residence as the wage assigned to sustained labor.

activation_trace.role: Collection and settlement of a debt supplies the image of an account being fully answered.
A worker's wage turns the lasting residence into compensation for labor.
Past temporal occurrence extends the labor across a course of life rather than one transaction.
Unfailing continuance supplies the unusual scale of the wage.

changed_reading.before: The residence is an unstructured gift after action.
changed_reading.after: The residence can initially be read as a settled, enduring wage for sustained labor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The garden at word 3, recompense at word 6, and intentional work at word 9 support a cultivation model, while the packet's non-dominant mapping for the recompense root activates ripeness and cutting.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intentional acts are cultivated growth; recompense is the moment at which that growth reaches readiness for harvest, and enduring residence is the protected yield rather than merely a later payment.

activation_trace.role: Dense, vigorous plant growth supplies the cultivated material that can mature.
The time when crop or flock is ripe for cutting converts recompense into a harvest threshold.
Ordinary action-response keeps the form-distant harvest image tethered to recompense.
Deliberate activity supplies cultivation rather than accidental growth.
Resistance to decay makes the harvested yield persist.

changed_reading.before: Reward is paid after deeds are finished.
changed_reading.after: Deeds are cultivated until a harvest threshold, and the lasting garden-company is their protected ripe yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence contrasts appointed limits, vanished generations, and a retrospectively brief stay with the focus participle of continuance; the straight stance before the focus becomes the temporal posture that is stabilized afterward.

activation_trace.role: Continuance resistant to decay supplies the unbounded side of the temporal contrast.
A fixed endpoint supplies the bounded temporal order against which focus continuance stands out.
Straight, balanced persistence supplies the lived stance that the focus residence can stabilize.
Generations passing away supply the historical vanishing that lasting residence reverses.
A stay in a place supplies the same durative category at a radically compressed worldly scale.

structural_cues: 46:13 places a continuation marker between confession and straight persistence immediately before the focus.
46:17-18 repeat the passing of earlier generations, while 46:35 compresses the perceived worldly stay to one hour.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied: bounded terms, straight persistence, elapsed generations, brief staying, and focus continuance. Reader arrow: sustained alignment under bounded time becomes a stabilized unbounded abode. Live alternative: continuance may simply name the promised result without mirroring prior steadfastness.

changed_reading.before: Endless duration is an added reward after deeds.
changed_reading.after: Worldly constancy within vanishing time is transposed into an unvanishing, stabilized mode of residence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah runs from parental bearing through separation and maturity to good work and repair of descendants. That sequence activates the focus branch in which a grown child becomes a companion and makes garden-company an intergenerational maturation rather than an aggregate of isolated earners.

activation_trace.role: A child reaching the stage of companionship supplies the exact relational hinge from maturation to company.
Concealed gestation gives the garden enclosure a developmental, generative resonance.
Parenthood by birth brackets the mature person's obligation backward toward parents and forward toward offspring.
Inward bearing of pregnancy or fruit supplies the long hidden labor from which maturity emerges.
Reaching an endpoint marks adulthood as achieved maturation rather than mere elapsed age.
Intentional good action locates mature agency inside the family sequence.
Fitness and mutual suitability let moral repair extend from the actor into descendants.

structural_cues: 46:15 follows the focus without a scene break and narrates gestation, weaning, adulthood, parents, and descendants in one arc.
46:16 then repeats the focus company and garden after evaluating the mature person's work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied: a full family lifecycle, a branch where the grown child becomes companion, and work directed across generations. Reader arrow: maturation composes the garden-company itself. Live alternative: 46:15 may exemplify one responsible worker without defining the social structure of all recipients.

changed_reading.before: Separate individuals receive a common destination for their separate deeds.
changed_reading.after: The destination can be read as mature intergenerational company formed by received care, responsible work, and repair carried into descendants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearest elaboration does not settle every deed symmetrically: it receives the best work, passes beyond bad acts, and grounds the outcome in a truthful promise. This revises the baseline wage-ledger into selective, gracious accounting.

activation_trace.role: Debt settlement supplies the strict accounting model that the adjacent ayah qualifies.
A laborer's wage supplies the apparently equivalent exchange that is being revised.
Reception with approval changes payment into welcomed acceptance.
Positive quality singled out against ugliness supplies a selective standard rather than an undifferentiated total.
Intentional deeds remain the anchored material being evaluated.
Passing beyond blame supplies the non-equivalent treatment of bad acts.
Badness supplies the material that is acknowledged yet not made determinative.
A promise that opens hope relocates assurance from earned equivalence to pledged fidelity.

structural_cues: 46:16 repeats the demonstrative, company, garden, and past work frame of 46:14, making it the closest internal expansion.
Acceptance of the best and passage over bad deeds are grammatically coordinated before the garden phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied: best work is accepted, bad acts are passed over, and the outcome is a truthful promise. Reader arrow: these operations specify how recompense works and defeat a one-to-one wage ledger. Live alternative: the focus may state desert while 46:16 separately adds mercy rather than redefining recompense.

changed_reading.before: Every deed is settled as an equivalent wage.
changed_reading.after: Recompense is a gracious selection that receives the best, passes beyond the bad, and rests on a faithful promise rather than arithmetic equivalence.

context_deltas.mechanism: 46:19 differentiates levels from deeds and then makes the deeds themselves the object of full rendering. Recompense therefore need not be an external item; action can return completed as the recipient's graded mode of residence.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing for another allows the resulting degree to embody and represent the deed.
Stepwise progression supplies differentiated levels rather than a binary destination alone.
The doubled intentional-action root makes deeds both the measure and what is rendered back.
Completion without deficit supplies the conversion of unfinished worldly action into a fully realized outcome.

structural_cues: 46:19 repeats the work root twice, first after the source marker for degrees and then as the direct object of full rendering.
The universal distributive at the start of 46:19 preserves individual differentiation inside the shared garden-company.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied: degrees arise from works and works are fully rendered. Reader arrow: the work becomes the form and degree of the lasting state rather than merely purchasing it. Live alternative: degrees and recompense may remain externally assigned rewards correlated with, but not transformed from, deeds.

changed_reading.before: Work earns a separate object called reward.
changed_reading.after: Work is completed back to the worker as a differentiated degree and mode of durable residence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah tests affiliations: invoked figures do not answer and become enemies, while answering the rightful caller leads to forgiveness and protected clientship; refusal leaves no ally. The focus company is thus the successful protective relation, not merely co-occupancy.

activation_trace.role: Preservation by accompaniment makes company the focus-side answer to failed affiliations.
A protective covering gives that valid affiliation a sheltering environment.
Failure of verbal response supplies the first test that false relations cannot pass.
Enmity supplies the reversal in which supposed allies become hostile at gathering.
An actual answering response supplies the positive relation that the earlier invocations lacked.
Protected nearness under pledged responsibility supplies the shelter produced by answering.
Affectionate support and alliance supply the protection explicitly absent from nonresponders.

structural_cues: 46:5-6 moves from unanswered invocation to hostile reversal at gathering.
46:31-32 repeats caller and answer language, pairing response with protection and nonresponse with the absence of allies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied: failed response, transformed enemies, successful response, protected nearness, and absent allies. Reader arrow: these relations define the social force of focus companionship and the shielding force of the garden. Live alternative: the affiliation sequence may only contrast belief choices while the focus nouns retain ordinary locative senses.

changed_reading.before: The garden protects a set of co-residents.
changed_reading.after: Garden-company is the successful protective affiliation constituted by answering the rightful call, opposite patrons who fail, turn hostile, or disappear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus work branch can denote a well-traversed road. Context then stages precedence toward good, straight standing, attentive hearing, a straight route, and response to a caller. Repeated action becomes path-making, and companions are those gathered by traversing it.

activation_trace.role: A road made passable by use turns habitual action into the laying down of a route.
Continued company supplies the cohort formed along the route.
Advancing ahead in a contest supplies movement toward the good rather than static possession of it.
Straight equilibrium supplies the route's sustained orientation.
Hearing that becomes understanding and compliance supplies the route's receptive entry act.
Attentive silence gives reception a deliberate bodily posture.
An extended route makes the movement image explicit in the later call.
Answering speech converts heard guidance into enacted movement.

structural_cues: 46:11 joins precedence toward good to the opponents' failure to become guided.
46:29-31 forms a listen, attend, return, call, and answer sequence, while the focus past-imperfect construction marks repeated practice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied: road, precedence, straightness, compliant hearing, and answering. Reader arrow: repeated deeds wear the guided route into existence and gather its travelers as companions. Live alternative: the route language may describe ethical orientation without converting work itself into a path.

changed_reading.after: Repeated responsive action lays a straight, traversable route and gathers the company that reaches its durable destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: 46:26 inventories hearing, sight, and hearts, then shows that unused faculties cannot avail their holders when knowing denial governs them. The focus work can therefore be embodied operation of the faculties rather than abstract deed units.

activation_trace.role: Working bodily members supply an embodied reading of action.
Audition that should become understanding and compliance supplies one active faculty whose failure matters.
Inner discernment supplies more than passive visual possession.
The heart as an internally kindled center supplies affective and volitional work.
Practical sufficiency supplies the outcome that merely possessed faculties fail to produce.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the blockage that makes endowed faculties ineffective.

structural_cues: 46:26 first lists three endowed faculties and then repeats each in a coordinated negation of benefit.
46:29 later reverses the failed-hearing pattern by making hearing proceed to attention and response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied: bodily faculties, their failed benefit, knowing denial, and later responsive hearing. Reader arrow: the focus work is the successful deployment of those faculties. Live alternative: the faculty inventory may establish culpable evidence without specifying the semantic content of work in 46:14.

changed_reading.before: Work is a generic ledger of deeds.
changed_reading.after: Work is embodied use of hearing, sight, and heart, and recompense answers whether those faculties became discerning and responsive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus formula is mirrored by punishment scenes in which consumed worldly goods, recompense, tasting, and habitual denial become an experienced state. The garden can thus be read as the positive inhabitable consequence of practice, not an arbitrary external prize.

activation_trace.role: Action answered by an outcome supplies the positive side of the mirrored consequence.
A cultivated enclosure lets the positive consequence be inhabited rather than merely credited.
Consumable benefit supplies the exhausted worldly counterpart to enduring enjoyment.
The same action-response mechanism operating punitively establishes a symmetrical frame around the focus.
Experiential testing makes consequence something undergone, not merely declared.
Concealment of recognized truth supplies the habitual practice answered by the punitive state.

structural_cues: 46:14 and 46:20 both combine recompense with a causal marker and a past habitual construction.
46:34 closes another presentation scene with the same causal habitual frame, now attached to tasting punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied: parallel causal formulas, positive and punitive recompense, spent benefits, and experienced punishment. Reader arrow: repeated practice becomes an inhabitable or undergoable state. Live alternative: the parallels may establish legal proportionality without implying transformation of practice into state.

changed_reading.before: The garden is a prize externally assigned after conduct.
changed_reading.after: The garden is the positive experiential state in which a life-pattern is answered in kind, mirroring the punitive states elsewhere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The maturation sequence after the focus supports a ripe-yield reading, while the apparent rain cloud that becomes a destroying wind and the later recompense of offenders supply its negative reversal. The focus garden preserves one harvest; the destructive sequence cuts another down to empty habitations.

activation_trace.role: Vigorous interwoven growth supplies the positive crop-like material.
Ripeness for cutting supplies the focus harvest threshold.
Inward bearing of child or fruit supplies protected development before emergence.
Arrival at maturity confirms a timed ripening process immediately after the focus.
Water expected from cloud supplies the anticipated nourishment that the narrative reverses.
Moving air replaces expected rain and becomes the carrier of the negative harvest.
Root-and-branch destruction supplies the stripping action of the negative harvest.
Cutting at the context occurrence of recompense directly reactivates the non-dominant harvest target.
Cutting and crop removal make the named offenders the object of a destructive harvest image.

structural_cues: 46:15 follows the focus with a long maturation sequence from bearing to full strength.
46:24 reverses an expected rain-bearing cloud into punitive wind, and 46:25 follows total destruction with another recompense formula and only dwellings visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied: growth, bearing, maturity, expected rain, destructive wind, cutting branches, and repeated recompense. Reader arrow: these form opposed harvests, one preserved in the focus garden and one stripped to habitations. Live alternative: the non-dominant mapping may be only form proximity, and the destruction account may illustrate punishment without an intended harvest mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus offers a generic figurative harvest of good deeds.
changed_reading.after: The focus company is the protected ripe yield of cultivation, set against a deceptive and destructive harvest that leaves a people cut down to empty dwellings.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates hospitality and enrollment branches from the descent and book roots in 46:2, not their immediate surface senses. It remains valid because prepared accommodation and cohort inscription attach directly to the focus garden and companion nouns. Downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain activation, not as a lexical gloss or exclusive interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The garden and companion nouns at words 2-3 can receive a prepared-place and enrolled-cohort mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Continued company supplies the cohort that can be received together.
The cultivated enclosure supplies the place prepared for that cohort.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest recasts the garden as received hospitality rather than acquired property.
Entering a name into a register or group supplies formal incorporation into the companion cohort.

changed_reading.before: Recipients own or occupy a rewarded estate.
changed_reading.after: A named cohort is received into prepared hospitality, so garden residence appears as welcomed placement and incorporation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets hidden-being and massed-collectivity branches echo inside the ordinary garden noun. It remains anchored through the focus garden-company and through the later hidden listeners who respond and warn their people. Downstream prose should qualify it as a possible expansion of the company across visible and hidden communities, never as a replacement sense for the garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The companion noun at word 2 and the concealment-family garden noun at word 3 can carry a hidden collective resonance.

activation_trace.role: Continued association supplies a company able to include more than one visible social kind.
A mass or gathered body of people activates collectivity inside the garden root family.
Hidden beings supply an explicitly non-visible community in the surrounding judgment sequence.
Visible humanity supplies the paired social kind against which hidden beings are named.
The later hidden listeners make that community active rather than merely listed.
A mobilized supporting group supplies the small responsive company that returns to warn others.
Hearing that becomes compliance supplies the same response criterion across hidden and visible communities.

changed_reading.before: The garden-company is imagined as an ordinary visible human group.
changed_reading.after: The responsive company may be imagined as a partly concealed collectivity spanning visible and hidden communities while remaining the garden's companions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it combines hair retained on processed hide, shorn residue, covering, destruction, and forgiveness. It remains anchored in three exact focus branches and in the later sequence where destruction leaves dwellings while forgiveness protects from an act's effect. Downstream prose should mark it as a branch-distant image of selective preservation through judgment, not as etymology or a literal description of the garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The companion, garden, and recompense roots at words 2, 3, and 6 jointly permit an image of what remains attached and covered through a stripping process.

activation_trace.role: Hair deliberately left attached to hide during processing supplies preservation through stripping.
Concealment under a covering supplies protection for what remains.
Shorn fleece or material left by cutting supplies the residue selected out by the process.
Comprehensive destruction supplies the severe stripping side of judgment.
A place of settled dwelling supplies the visible remainder after the destructive passage.
Covering a fault while shielding its bearer from the effect supplies selective preservation rather than denial of judgment.

changed_reading.before: Judgment simply pays out deeds and assigns a destination.
changed_reading.after: Garden companionship can be pictured as what remains attached, covered, and inhabitable after judgment strips away what cannot endure.

strongest_changes: 46:16 revises strict wage accounting into acceptance of the best, passage over bad acts, and reliance on a faithful promise.
46:15 activates mature parent-child companionship and makes the garden-company an intergenerational process rather than a set of isolated earners.
46:19 makes works return as fully rendered degrees, so recompense can be the realized form of action rather than a separate object.
The failed-patron and answered-caller sequences make companionship a protective affiliation and the garden its shielding environment.
The non-dominant recompense mapping, maturation sequence, and destructive wind preserve a live contrast between protected and destructive harvests.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made unusually concrete branches cohere: a grown child becoming a companion, a fetus and vigorous growth within the garden root family, action as a worn road or working limbs, and the split recompense root as ripening and cutting. Context did not force one synthesis; it turned these into coexisting social, developmental, procedural, embodied, and ecological readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The harvest mechanism depends on a non-dominant mapped target and may reflect productive form proximity rather than semantic intention.
The family lifecycle may define garden-company or may only supply one exemplary biography within it.
The claim that action becomes an inhabitable state is an inferred directional arrow; legal proportionality remains live.
The mixed visible-hidden company and retained-covering readings are well anchored but should remain explicitly exploratory.
